_meta.purpose: WP-A02 Gate A — frozen request/response shape fixtures for 10 representative Finance endpoints, derived STATICALLY from TypeScript interfaces/zod schemas/inline body reads found in the route source files. NOT captured from a live request/response — no server was run, no database was touched, per the hard ban in this task's brief.
_meta.sourceMasterPlan: docs/validation/finance-v3/FINANCE_IMPLEMENTATION_MASTER_PLAN_2026-08-09.md — NOT FOUND in this worktree (EVIDENCE_MISSING); fixtures selection and shape derivation are based purely on the route source files cited per fixture.
_meta.method: static code reading only — TS interfaces, zod schemas, and inline destructured request bodies as written in the cited source files
_meta.selectionRationale: Picked to cover: the most idempotency-critical endpoint (statement upload), the FIN-03/04 idempotency+CAS pattern on models, the documented Date-leak split-brain pair, a legacy-only (no v8 equivalent) write endpoint, the undocumented /analyses vs /financial-analyses split-brain pair, a cross-module FIN-06 candidate-handoff bridge, the third undocumented 'finance value' contract, and the Idempotency-Key-REQUIRED post-investment-review endpoint that crosses into the Results module.

headers.Idempotency-Key: string, optional but drives retry-safety; IdempotencyKeyTooLongError -> 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LONG if oversized

success_201_smart.analysis: object — multi-section LLM analysis result, cannot be honestly reconstructed from an id alone (per code comment)

idempotency.notes: This is the v8 twin of legacy POST /api/finance-statements/upload-and-analyze; code comment at finance.routes.ts:1376-1380 explicitly names the legacy route as sharing the same defect class/fix pattern.

fixtures.legacyTwin: POST /api/finance-statements/upload-and-analyze (server/src/routes/finance-statements.routes.ts, line 1097) — same idempotency machinery, separate helper buildUploadAndAnalyzeRecoveryResponseBody

idempotency.notes: FIN-03/FIN-04: a double-click save or network retry replaying the same POST with the same Idempotency-Key returns the ORIGINAL model/scenario, never mints a second one.

fixtures.legacyTwin: POST /api/financial-modeling/models (server/src/routes/financial-modeling.routes.ts, line 170) — createModelSchema (zod, exported for Health Panel probe), NO idempotency-key support at all — a genuine capability gap vs the v8 twin.

fixtures.note: Documented split-brain pair — same 'Date leak' defect class confirmed by an explicit in-file comment naming the other side.

pair.response: model detail object including events[] and source_statement/source_statement_pack (serialized date fields)

pair.codeComment: "FIN-005: same Date leak as the v8 model-detail route — see there." (line 326)

headers.X-Model-Version: number, optional — optimistic-concurrency CAS token, alt via body.expectedVersion

idempotency.mechanism: Idempotency-Key check; a double-click 'save version' retry with the same key returns the already-approved outcome instead of bumping the version a second time.
idempotency.concurrencyControl: expectedVersion / X-Model-Version CAS — same pattern documented as mirroring presentations.routes.ts's deck version guard

fixtures.legacyTwin: POST /api/financial-modeling/models/:id/approve (financial-modeling.routes.ts, line 538) — NO CAS, NO idempotency-key; simple {success:true, status:'approved'}.

fixtures.note: LEGACY-ONLY end-to-end: v8/finance.routes.ts exposes only GET /finance/valuations (read-only list) — there is no v8 write path today. Frontend confirmed caller: CreateValuationModal.tsx, ValuationWorkspace.tsx (11 raw fetch calls in this file targeting /economics/valuations*).

body.title: string, required
body.depth: enum('managerial'|'banking'), optional — F-4 additive switch, omitted means byte-identical old behavior

fixtures.note: v8/finance.routes.ts exposes GET+POST /finance/budgets only (create + list) — lines/scenarios/approve/import-document/initiatives management exists ONLY under /api/economics. Confirmed FE caller: CreateBudgetModal.tsx.

Undocumented split-brain — near 1:1 suffix match (run/approve/ratios/initiative-proposals/initiatives) between two different tables/services, no code comment on either side acknowledging the other (unlike F3). Both sides have confirmed live frontend consumers via a v8-first/legacy-fallback wrapper pattern (useFinanceData.ts, useFinanceRowActions.ts, FinancialAnalysisWorkspace.tsx).

pair.response: { data: { analyses, count }, meta } — backed by financial_analyses table
{ analyses } — via finAnalysisSvc, likely same underlying financial_analyses table through a different service layer

fixtures.alsoNoteDistinctResource: economics.routes.ts ALSO exposes a differently-shaped /analyses resource (digitization_analyses table — npv/roi/currency/axisScores) that is NOT the same concept as /financial-analyses, adding a third name collision worth resolving before Gate A closes.

fixtures.note: FIN-06 one-way bridge FROM the Finance domain (approved financial_models) INTO initiative_candidates (Ideas/Initiatives module). Explicitly designed to never touch the frozen finance-statements/financial-modeling/economics runtimes — out of scope for the v3 engine rewrite, contract stays exactly as-is.

auth.expected: requireUser(req) only — throws plain Error('Unauthorized'), not mapped to a clean 401 by mapError
auth.warning: Gateway.ts mounts this router with NO middleware at all (app.use('/api/finance/candidate-handoff/investment-case', financeCandidateHandoffInvestmentCaseRoutes) — no verifyToken). This differs from its two siblings (statement-pack uses router.use(verifyToken, isAuthenticated); valuation-recommendation uses per-route verifyToken). Flagged as a correctness/security issue independent of the API freeze — recommend fixing in the same window as adapter work, not deferring.

idempotency.mechanism: domain-level create-or-return keyed by (organizationId, modelId) uniqueness in the underlying service — NOT a client-supplied Idempotency-Key header

fixtures.note: Part of the THIRD, undocumented 'finance value' contract surface — this file double-mounts at both /api/v8/finance/value/* (canonical, restored after being lost in a 2026-06-25 rebase) and /api/v8/finance-value/* (alias). Called RAW by src/components/Economics/panels/InvestmentAppraisalPanel.tsx via Api.post — no typed client wraps this mount (the typed financeValue.ts client only covers the SEPARATE /api/v8/finance/value-tracking mount — do not confuse the two).
auth: resolveOrganizationId(req) — local helper, distinct from getV8Context used elsewhere in v8 routes; 401 if org id absent

body.initialInvestment: number, optional — auto-derived from first negative cash flow if 0/omitted

idempotency.mechanism: none found — pure stateless compute, no DB access

fixtures.demoGuardRisk: This route is POST with no GET counterpart; demoWriteProtection classifies purely by HTTP verb, so this pure-compute endpoint 403s in demo mode despite touching no database. financeValueDemoAllowlist.ts (unmounted proposal) explicitly lists this route as an exemption candidate with this exact caller confirmed.

fixtures.note: Cross-module contract: consumed by the Results module (PostInvestmentActualForm.tsx), not just Finance's own UI. Adapter must preserve this contract byte-for-byte since the Results module code is out of scope for this program.

headers.Idempotency-Key: string, REQUIRED — 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED if absent (this is the only endpoint across all 293 inventoried that hard-requires the header rather than treating it as optional)

response.error_other: 400/422/404 typed error codes for baseline/version/statement mismatches

idempotency.mechanism: const operationKey = req.headers['idempotency-key']; if (!operationKey) return 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED
idempotency.notes: The strictest idempotency contract in the whole Finance surface — required, not optional, unlike F1/F2/F4 which treat the header as optional-but-recommended.
